entry.gloss: skillful; dexterous; handy; clever with one's hands

definitions.gloss: skillful; dexterous; handy; clever with one's hands
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is good with their hands or skilled at performing tasks that require manual dexterity or practical ability.

definitions.gloss: versatile; able to handle things smoothly
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who can adapt to various situations and handle different tasks competently, sometimes with a nuance of being too slick or superficial.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手先|てさき}→手先：12939_tesaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{器用|きよう}だ。
examples.english: He is good with his hands.

examples.japanese: {器用|きよう}に⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つまむ→つまむ：10374_tsumamu⟧。
examples.english: To skillfully pick up beans with chopsticks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{器用|きよう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧で、⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{裁縫|さいほう}→裁縫：04163_saihou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧なん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: My mother is handy — she can do everything from cooking to sewing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{器用|きよう}になん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧。
examples.english: He handles everything capably.

examples.japanese: {器用|きよう}に⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: He smoothly changed the subject.

examples.japanese: {器用貧乏|きようびんぼう}で、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦そこそこ→そこそこ：06684_sokosoko⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}められない→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧。
examples.english: He's a jack-of-all-trades — decent at everything but unable to master any one thing.

entry.notes:
Primarily describes manual dexterity, but extends to general competence and adaptability. The opposite is ⟦{不器用|ぶきよう}→不器用：06642_bukiyou⟧ (clumsy, awkward).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{手先|てさき}→手先：12939_tesaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{器用|きよう}→器用：02655_kiyou⟧: good with one's hands
- {器用|きよう}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a handy/skilled person
- {器用|きよう}に⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧: to handle skillfully
- {器用貧乏|きようびんぼう}: jack-of-all-trades, master of none

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧な: good at / skilled — more general term for being good at something
- ⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧な: skillful / masterful — literary; implies artistic or refined skill
- ⟦{不器用|ぶきよう}→不器用：06642_bukiyou⟧な: clumsy / awkward — the direct antonym

CULTURAL NOTE:
The compound {器用貧乏|きようびんぼう} (literally "skilled poverty") describes someone who can do many things well but never excels at one, carrying a slightly negative nuance. It reflects the Japanese cultural value of mastering one craft deeply rather than being a generalist.

definitions.gloss: prototype; trial product; sample
definitions.explanation: A product made on a trial basis before mass production. Used in manufacturing, technology, cooking, and other fields where items are tested before final release.

examples.japanese: {試作品|しさくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make a prototype.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{試作品|しさくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Testing of the new prototype has begun.

examples.japanese: {試作品|しさくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{量産|りょうさん}→量産：14441_ryousan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{不具合|ふぐあい}→不具合：06413_fuguai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: There were no problems at the prototype stage, but defects appeared during mass production.

entry.notes:
Composed of ⟦{試作|しさく}→試作：20405_shisaku⟧ (trial manufacture) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (product). Refers to an early version of a product created for evaluation and testing before committing to full production.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試作品|しさくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a prototype
- {試作品|しさくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: prototype testing
- {試作品|しさくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧: prototype stage
- {試作品|しさくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完成|かんせい}させる: to complete a prototype

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見本|みほん}→見本：00279_mihon⟧: sample — a finished product shown as a representative example, not necessarily a test version
- ⟦{模型|もけい}→模型：07079_mokei⟧: model — a scaled or simplified representation, not a functional trial product
- プロトタイプ: prototype — the English loanword, used more in tech/startup contexts

sol_flags.concern: The etymology reverses the components' meanings: 引っ切り refers to cutting off or interruption, not rapid succession; なし negates that interruption.
sol_flags.suggestion: Replace the etymology with: "From 引っ切り (cutting off; interruption) + なし (without): literally, without interruption."

decisions.note: etymology reversed

definitions.gloss: incessantly; without pause; nonstop
definitions.explanation: Describes something that continues without any break or interruption. Used for repeated actions or a continuous stream of events, people, or things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひっきりなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
examples.english: The phone rings nonstop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひっきりなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧{人気店|にんきてん}だ。
examples.english: It's a popular shop where customers come in nonstop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひっきりなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ってくる→入ってくる：29060_haittekuru⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the year, reservations for year-end parties come in without pause.

entry.notes:
An adverb meaning without interruption or cessation. Almost always used with the particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as ひっきりなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Describes a stream of events, visitors, calls, or other repeated occurrences that never lets up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ひっきりなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: to ring nonstop
- ひっきりなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to come without pause
- ひっきりなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue without a break
- ひっきりなし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to talk incessantly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絶|た}え{間|ま}なく: ceaselessly — more literary, can describe both discrete and continuous events
- ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧: continuously — broader usage, simply means "the whole time"
- ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without rest — emphasizes the lack of breaks rather than the frequency of occurrence

ETYMOLOGY:
From {引|ひ}っ{切|き}り (one after another) + なし (without end). The original meaning of {引|ひ}っ{切|き}り refers to things following one another in rapid succession.

sol_flags.concern: 当社比 indicates a comparison with the company's own products or figures, not with the company itself.
sol_flags.suggestion: Change the gloss to "compared with our own products or previous figures."

decisions.note: 当社比 compares own products

definitions.gloss: our company; this company
definitions.explanation: A formal way to refer to one's own company, used in business correspondence, press releases, official announcements, and corporate communications.

examples.japanese: {当社|とうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please use our company's products.

examples.japanese: {当社|とうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開始|かいし}します→開始する：26826_kaishisuru⟧。
examples.english: Our company will begin a new service starting next month.

examples.japanese: {当社|とうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧やすい⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧づくり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: Our company is committed to creating a comfortable working environment for employees.

entry.notes:
Composed of {当|とう} (this, the relevant) + ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (company). A formal, somewhat stiff way to refer to one's own company. Standard in business writing, corporate websites, and press releases. Not typically used in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当社|とうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: our company's products
- {当社|とうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: at our company
- {当社|とうしゃ}⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧: compared to our company
- {当社|とうしゃ}⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧: our company's regulations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧: our company (humble) — more humble and polite, used when addressing clients or external parties
- ⟦{自社|じしゃ}→自社：14070_jisha⟧: one's own company — neutral, often used in compound phrases like ⟦{自社|じしゃ}→自社：14070_jisha⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (in-house product)
- ⟦{御社|おんしゃ}→御社：17179_onsha⟧: your company (honorific) — used to respectfully refer to another person's company in speech
- ⟦{貴社|きしゃ}→貴社：15664_kisha⟧: your company (honorific) — the written equivalent of ⟦{御社|おんしゃ}→御社：17179_onsha⟧

REGISTER:
Formal business language. In conversation with external parties, ⟦{弊社|へいしゃ}→弊社：17404_heisha⟧ is often preferred as a more humble alternative. {当社|とうしゃ} is neutral-formal and common in internal documents and public announcements.

definitions.gloss: children's folk song; nursery rhyme
definitions.explanation: Traditional songs passed down orally among children over generations. Often accompanied by games, hand clapping, or other physical play.

examples.japanese: わらべうた⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧。
examples.english: To sing a children's folk song.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧わらべうた⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother often taught me nursery rhymes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧わらべうた⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{子|こ}どもたち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: At the daycare, they use nursery rhymes to play with the children every day.

entry.notes:
Composed of わらべ ({童|わらべ}, children) + うた (⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧, song). Refers to traditional folk songs for children that have been passed down through oral tradition. Many are accompanied by games like hand clapping, jump rope, or circle games.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- わらべうた⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧: to sing a nursery rhyme
- わらべうた⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧: nursery rhyme games
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧わらべうた: Japanese children's folk songs
- わらべうた⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to pass down nursery rhymes

TYPES:
Well-known わらべうた:
- かごめかごめ: Kagome Kagome (circle game song)
- ⟦{通|とお}りゃ→通る：01243_tooru⟧んせ: Toryanse (passing-through game)
- はないちもんめ: Hana Ichi Monme (team choosing game)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{童謡|どうよう}→童謡：03480_douyou⟧: children's song — composed songs for children, often with known authors, as opposed to traditional folk songs
- ⟦{子守歌|こもりうた}→子守歌：19434_komoriuta⟧: lullaby — songs specifically for putting children to sleep
- ⟦{唱歌|しょうか}→唱歌：21282_shouka⟧: school song — songs taught in the school music curriculum, often from the Meiji era onward

sol_flags.concern: 無色 means lacking color, not being transparent. Transparency is a separate property expressed by 透明.
sol_flags.suggestion: Remove “transparent”: “colorless; uncolored”.

decisions.note: 無色 is not transparent

definitions.gloss: colorless; uncolored; transparent
definitions.explanation: Having no color. Used to describe transparent liquids, gases, and other substances, as well as figuratively for things that are neutral or without character.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無色|むしょく}⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Water is colorless and transparent.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無色|むしょく}⟦{無臭|むしゅう}→無臭：16112_mushuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: This liquid is colorless and odorless, making it dangerous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}→一酸化炭素：27606_issankatanso⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無色|むしょく}⟦{無臭|むしゅう}→無臭：16112_mushuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{漏|も}れ→漏れ：13362_more⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づきにくい。
examples.english: Carbon monoxide is a colorless, odorless gas, making leaks hard to detect.

entry.notes:
Composed of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + {色|しょく} (color). Describes the absence of color. Very commonly paired with ⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧ (transparent) or ⟦{無臭|むしゅう}→無臭：16112_mushuu⟧ (odorless) to describe substances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無色|むしょく}⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧: colorless and transparent
- {無色|むしょく}⟦{無臭|むしゅう}→無臭：16112_mushuu⟧: colorless and odorless
- {無色|むしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧: a colorless liquid
- {無色|むしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気体|きたい}→気体：02632_kitai⟧: a colorless gas

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧: transparent — lets light through but may have color (e.g., colored glass)
- ⟦{無職|むしょく}→無職：13386_mushoku⟧: unemployed — a homophone with a completely different meaning and kanji

USAGE:
Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{無職|むしょく}→無職：13386_mushoku⟧ (unemployed). The kanji make the distinction clear in writing.

entry.headword: {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}

definitions.gloss: certified public accountant (CPA)
definitions.explanation: A nationally licensed accounting professional in Japan who is authorized to perform audits, provide tax services, and offer financial consulting. One of the most prestigious professional qualifications in Japan.

examples.japanese: {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I passed the CPA exam.

examples.japanese: {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{監査|かんさ}→監査：05972_kansa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}した→依頼する：21376_irai⟧。
examples.english: We asked a certified public accountant to audit the financial statements.

examples.japanese: {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧{国家資格|こっかしかく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The CPA qualification is considered one of the most difficult national certifications in Japan.

entry.notes:
Composed of ⟦{公認|こうにん}→公認：11641_kounin⟧ (officially certified) + ⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧ (accounting) + ⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧ (professional, specialist). The Japanese CPA certification is considered one of the three most difficult national examinations, alongside the bar exam ({司法試験|しほうしけん}) and the medical exam.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: CPA exam
- {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧: to hire a CPA
- {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧: CPA qualification
- {公認会計士|こうにんかいけいし}⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧: CPA office / accounting firm

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{税理士|ぜいりし}→税理士：06571_zeirishi⟧: tax accountant — specializes in tax filing and advice; a separate qualification from CPA

definitions.gloss: oversupply; glut; excess supply
definitions.explanation: A situation where the supply of a product or service exceeds demand, often leading to falling prices. A key concept in economics and business.

entry.notes:
Composed of ⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧ (supply) + ⟦{過剰|かじょう}→過剰：04123_kajou⟧ (excess, surplus). An economic term describing a market condition where supply outstrips demand. The opposite situation is ⟦{供給不足|きょうきゅうぶそく}→供給不足：30658_kyoukyuubusoku⟧ (supply shortage).
